about_the_game:
Silicon Girl is an erotic interactive game focused on customization and intimate first-person scenes.

You receive the prototype of the "Silicon Girl" — an experimental android companion. She comes with multiple appearances, hairstyles, and outfits to unlock. By progressing through intimate scenes, you earn gear currency that can be spent on customization.

Every scene drains her battery. Once the energy is gone, the test ends. To experience all content and collect every trophy, you’ll need to replay and choose different combinations.

Silicon Girl is about making choices with limited resources — unlock more intimate scenes or spend your gears on customization.

Features:


  • 8 unique robot skins.
  • 6 hairstyles and multiple outfits to customize.
  • 15 interactive sex animations.
  • Collectible trophies — special rendered cards for each scene.
  • Battery system — limited charge that encourages replayability.
  • Gear currency — earn in scenes, spend on customization.
  • Focused on interactive intimacy, without unnecessary text.

content_descriptors.notes:
All characters are adults. The game is intended for adults only. 

This game contains explicit sexual content, including full nudity, vaginal intercourse, anal intercourse, and oral sex.
